name: Antipodally Punctured Cube
definition: For $n\geq3$, the **antipodally punctured cube** is $\mathcal P_n:=2^{[n]}\setminus\{\emptyset,[n]\}$: the full $n$-cube with its all-zero and all-one vertices deleted.
comments: It has high minimum 1-inclusion degree but no codimension-one subcube, making it a finite strict counterexample for strongly-shattered-set versus minimum-degree comparisons.
